declaration-property-value-allowed-list.message: Token gate (tz-whitelabel §3.1): font-size / border-radius / box-shadow / font-family take var(--…) tokens only (variables.css); font-family may also be inherit.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Token gate (2026-10-31): padding / margin / inset / gap / scroll-padding / scroll-margin take spacing tokens -- var(--space-*), var(--velo-gap-*), var(--velo-inset-*) or calc() of them (calc(-1 * var(--space-2)) for a negative). Allowed raw: 0, auto, %, viewport units, env(), unitless calc factors, and a fallback inside var(--token, 12px). No other exceptions.
